compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: Pre-Phase-1 baseline bridge-fsck label-only-orphan count captured + attached to epic ticket BEFORE any reconciler pass; audit fails closed if baseline missing

Create plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/audits/audit_dd1_baseline.sh. Sources audit_dd4_phase_gate.sh; calls check_phase_gate first. Invokes bridge-fsck in count-only mode; writes structured JSON to .reconciler-audit-artifacts/<phase>/dd1.json with {phase, captured_at, label_only_orphan_count, bridge_fsck_command, git_sha}. Fails closed (exit 3) if bridge-fsck returns non-zero or count cannot be parsed.

## Test Approach
Given stubbed bridge-fsck prints 'label_only_orphans=197'; When audit_dd1_baseline.sh 1 invoked with phase-gate satisfied; Then dd1.json exists with count=197 + script exits 0. Given bridge-fsck stub exits non-zero; Then exit 3 + no artifact.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] shellcheck + executable: shellcheck plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/audits/audit_dd1_baseline.sh && test -x plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/audits/audit_dd1_baseline.sh
- [ ] Successful capture writes valid JSON with required fields
  Verify: bash tests/unit/scripts/test_audit_dd1_baseline.sh::test_capture_writes_json
- [ ] Phase-gate refusal short-circuits capture
  Verify: bash tests/unit/scripts/test_audit_dd1_baseline.sh::test_gate_refusal_short_circuits
- [ ] Fails closed when bridge-fsck errors (exit 3, no artifact)
  Verify: bash tests/unit/scripts/test_audit_dd1_baseline.sh::test_fails_closed_on_fsck_error

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/audits/audit_dd1_baseline.sh — Create
- tests/unit/scripts/test_audit_dd1_baseline.sh — Create

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)

comments.body: REVISION_CYCLE_1: bridge-fsck count extraction strategy — bridge-fsck (ticket-bridge-fsck.py) CLI does NOT have --count-only mode currently. Two paths: (a) PREFERRED: invoke bridge_fsck.enumerate_orphan_anomalies Python API via subprocess (python3 -c 'from plugins.dso.scripts.dso_reconciler.bridge_fsck import enumerate_orphan_anomalies; import json; print(json.dumps(enumerate_orphan_anomalies(...)))') and parse structured JSON output — this avoids fragile report parsing. (b) FALLBACK: if API import fails, parse the human-readable 'label_only_orphan' section of the report via well-anchored regex. AC verifies path (a) works; path (b) is fallback only. Add prerequisite check: bridge_fsck.enumerate_orphan_anomalies importable; fail with exit 7 (new code) if not.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: REVISION_CYCLE_2: Add RED test for ImportError exit-7 path. Spec: stub the python -c subprocess to raise ImportError (e.g., remove bridge_fsck module from sys.path); invoke audit_dd1_baseline.sh; assert exit code == 7 + stderr diagnostic identifies the missing API. Also add RED test for fallback regex path: provide fixture file containing representative bridge-fsck human-readable report; assert extracted count matches expected value. Mark fallback test with 'fallback-path' tag.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): bridge-fsck invocation path pinned to CLI-JSON (NOT importlib-from-hyphenated-filename). Hyphenated filename 'ticket-bridge-fsck.py' blocks direct Python import. Use: subprocess invokes 'python3 plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-bridge-fsck.py --json' and parses structured JSON output. dd1.json contract field api_path_used values: 'cli-json' (preferred) | 'regex-fallback'. Add RED test asserting cli-json preferred when --json flag available. Rationale: ambiguous import vs subprocess path would force importlib hacks or silent regex degradation (implicit_assumption).
